faqs.question: What does AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex measure?
faqs.answer: This test determines the susceptibility of the MTb complex to the drug capreomycin.

faqs.question: Why is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex done?
faqs.answer: • This test measures the susceptibility of the TB bacteria to capreomycin, helping determine whether this drug will be effective in treating the TB infection. • It is also helpful in cases where there is resistance to standard TB medications or when a patient has not responded well to initial treatment.

faqs.question: When is AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended when: • A patient has been diagnosed with TB and requires drug susceptibility testing. • Standard TB medications have not been effective. • There is concern about resistance to TB drugs. • Determining the effectiveness of capreomycin treatment is necessary.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate resistance to capreomycin, which means alternative treatment options need to be explored.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: During this test, a sample of TB bacteria is obtained from a pure culture or a specific testing tube which will be sent to the lab for drug susceptibility testing and analysis.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex?
faqs.answer: • Drug susceptibility testing for other TB drugs • Molecular diagnostic tests to identify specific strains of TB bacteria • Chest X-ray or other imaging studies to evaluate lung involvement in TB

faqs.question: What is the AFB (TB) – Antibiogram for MTb Complex – Capreomycin Drug by MGIT – Pure Growth of MTB Complex also known as?
faqs.answer: Capreomycin Susceptibility Test, AFB Capreomycin Drug Sensitivity Test

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis (TB)?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is an infectious disease caused by the Mycobacterium tuberculosis bacteria. It primarily affects the lungs, but can also impact other organs. TB spreads through the air when an infected person coughs or sneezes. Symptoms include persistent cough, weight loss, fever, and fatigue.
